scripts._comment_tools: Everything below is a one-line delegation so repo-level tools are typed the short way: `yarn db:seed`, not `yarn workspace @fpay/backend db:seed`. The whole db:* family is aliased rather than only the documented ones — `yarn db:migrate` working while `yarn db:new` does not is a worse trap than neither existing. Deliberately NOT aliased: per-app `build` / `start`, because the Vercel configs (root vercel.json for web, apps/{admin,lp,landing}/vercel.json), the repo-root Dockerfile's CMD (`db:deploy && start` — that string moved there when railway.json's startCommand was removed) and .githooks/pre-push run those exact strings, and a second way to say them is a second thing to drift.
scripts._comment_checks: The self-checks: every one is plain node with no DB and no network, so check:all runs anywhere in about a second. It is `check:all` and not `check` because `yarn check` is a Yarn 1 BUILTIN (lockfile verifier) and builtins resolve ahead of scripts — a script named `check` would be silently shadowed.
